$AMD Monthly $200 Incoming 🎯

The last time $AMD confirmed a higher low on the monthly BX while sitting in a Smart Money Zone, it ran over 200 percent in 18 months.

I tried timing this early back in November and got burned for it.

But this is the first month in over a year showing a real sign of higher lows on the BX, which could mark a true bottom.

What I want to see now is either multiple months of higher lows or a full flip to green.

I’ve officially turned my $AMD bots back on and I still hold a target of 200 dollars or more by the end of 2025.

Volume is thin from 125 to 200 and if we break out, it could rip fast just like it did last time.

$AAPL Monthly Discount Range 👀

We’re testing the monthly market bias again. The last six times $AAPL hit this level, institutions stepped in hard and pushed the stock to new highs.

I was a buyer at $170 two months ago.

But now I’m sitting out until we get at least one full month of higher lows on the BX Trender.

Breaking the market bias is extremely rare. The only times we’ve seen that happen for any real length were in 2016, 2013, and during the 2008 crash.

If you’re bullish on Apple, history says this is a solid zone to accumulate. But for me, I’m staying patient and waiting for confirmation.

$META Monthly 

We pulled back perfectly to the top band of the monthly market bias at $500 and bounced clean. This is exactly where institutions usually step in to buy the dip during bullish trends and strong structure.

But the BX Trender is still red, even as we print a higher low. That means buying pressure hasn’t confirmed yet.

There’s a chance we just break out to all-time highs from here. But I’m staying patient.

Here’s my plan:

If the BX Trender flips green this month, that would give us confirmation for a potential multi-month or even multi-year expansion — just like the move from January 2023 to January 2025 when $META ran 300 percent.

But I think there’s a real chance we get one more rejection. If we pull back to $500 or even $450, I’ll look to turn on my bots and time the dip with institutions.

Until then, I’m not chasing. The juice isn’t worth the squeeze just yet.

$NKE Monthly 

Everyone keeps trying to time the bottom on Nike, but nothing has confirmed yet. ❌

Yes, we’re trading at a massive discount. Yes, we’re approaching a strong volume shelf. But that doesn’t mean the bottom is in.

One of the biggest lessons I’ve learned in 11 years of trading is this: buying a discount means nothing without confirmation. I

’d rather miss the first 10 to 15 percent of a move than catch a falling knife.

Right now, we need at least a higher low on the monthly BX Trender. Ideally, we wait until it turns green.

Strong support plus real buying pressure. That’s the combo we need before any serious move can happen.

$UNH Monthly — Is This the Bottom? 🤞

We’re sitting right on top of a massive smart money zone near $300.

This is the level where institutions have historically stepped in and stopped the bleeding. It’s a textbook area for a bounce.

But here’s the truth, nothing is confirmed yet.

Yes, we’re at a discount. Yes, we’re sitting on a major support. But we have zero signs that buyers are stepping in.

For confirmation, I need to see at least one higher low on the BX Trender. That won’t be possible until July.

Even the weekly BX is still printing lower lows, which means buyers haven’t shown up yet.

This could end up being a massive play into late 2025 or early 2026, but I’m not touching it until I see one of those two signals fire.
